answer: APPROVE. PR #12 introduces zero new crate dependencies. The gh-meta file list (9 files) contains no Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock entries; the only apparent Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock string hits in the diff are payload strings inside the deleted .audit/agent-read.jsonl session log (historical read-event records), not actual manifest mutations. The two Rust changes (kernel lib.rs +3/-3, app main.rs +1/-1) are pure string-literal path rewrites from deploy/gitops/oya-vcs-admission to infra/kyverno/oya-vcs-admission. No new external resource references are introduced: the ARGO_MANIFEST constant remains a workspace-relative path loaded by fs::read_to_string at main.rs:145 (unchanged loader; no http://, file://, oci://, or helm scheme added). The only http/https URLs in the diff (https://kubernetes.default.svc, https://github.com) are pre-existing — the kubernetes.default.svc URLs reside inside the git-renamed application.json (rename detected by git, semantics unchanged) and the github.com URL appears in the renamed application.json's repoURL field, also unchanged in semantics. Both touched crates (oya-foundry-vcs-provider-execution-gate-kernel, -app) still declare serde_json as their sole non-internal workspace dependency. No dependency-rationales.json gate is bypassed; no cargo-deny surface is altered. ADR-0092 seam policy is not invoked because no seam/adapter/registry boundary is crossed.
